mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auto_saving ( user_id, money_box_id, account_id, max_amount, auto_saving_status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{moneyBoxId}, #{accountId}, #{maxAmount}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: SELECT auto_saving_id AS autoSavingId, user_id AS userId, money_box_id AS moneyBoxId, account_id AS accountId, max_amount AS maxAmount, auto_saving_status AS autoSavingStatus FROM auto_saving WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT a.auto_saving_id, a.auto_saving_status AS status, a.max_amount, m.money_box_id, m.balance, mba.masked_account_number, CASE WHEN h.auto_saving_history_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS todaySaved, h.amount AS todaySavingAmount FROM auto_saving a INNER JOIN money_box m ON a.money_box_id = m.money_box_id LEFT JOIN account mba ON m.account_id = mba.account_id LEFT JOIN auto_saving_history h ON a.auto_saving_id = h.auto_saving_id AND h.transacted_at = CURDATE() WHERE a.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auto_saving_history WHERE auto_saving_id = #{autoSavingId} AND transacted_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND transacted_at < DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(CURDATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT CASE week_days.day_index WHEN 0 THEN 'MONDAY' WHEN 1 THEN 'TUESDAY' WHEN 2 THEN 'WEDNESDAY' WHEN 3 THEN 'THURSDAY' WHEN 4 THEN 'FRIDAY' WHEN 5 THEN 'SATURDAY' WHEN 6 THEN 'SUNDAY' END AS dayOfWeek, CASE WHEN h.auto_saving_history_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS saved, h.amount FROM (SELECT 0 AS day_index UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6) week_days LEFT JOIN auto_saving_history h ON h.auto_saving_id = #{autoSavingId} AND h.transacted_at = DATE_ADD( DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL week_days.day_index DAY ) ORDER BY week_days.day_index
SELECT transacted_at FROM auto_saving_history WHERE auto_saving_id = #{autoSavingId} AND transacted_at <= CURDATE() ORDER BY transacted_at DESC LIMIT 60
SELECT g.goal_id, g.goal_name, g.goal_type, g.goal_amount FROM goal g WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} AND g.goal_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY g.created_at DESC

SELECT ga.goal_id, ga.asset_type, ga.asset_id, CASE WHEN ga.asset_type = 'ACCOUNT' THEN fi.financial_institution_name WHEN ga.asset_type = 'MONEY_BOX' THEN mbfi.financial_institution_name ELSE NULL END AS financial_institution_name, CASE WHEN ga.asset_type = 'ACCOUNT' THEN a.masked_account_number WHEN ga.asset_type = 'MONEY_BOX' THEN mba.masked_account_number ELSE NULL END AS masked_account_number, CASE WHEN ga.asset_type = 'ACCOUNT' THEN a.balance WHEN ga.asset_type = 'MONEY_BOX' THEN m.balance ELSE 0 END AS balance FROM goal g INNER JOIN goal_asset ga ON g.goal_id = ga.goal_id LEFT JOIN account a ON ga.asset_type = 'ACCOUNT' AND ga.asset_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN financial_institution fi ON a.financial_institution_id = fi.financial_institution_id LEFT JOIN money_box m ON ga.asset_type = 'MONEY_BOX' AND ga.asset_id = m.money_box_id
LEFT JOIN account mba ON m.account_id = mba.account_id LEFT JOIN financial_institution mbfi ON mba.financial_institution_id = mbfi.financial_institution_id WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} AND g.goal_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ga.asset_type IN ('ACCOUNT', 'MONEY_BOX') ORDER BY ga.goal_id, ga.goal_asset_id

SELECT DISTINCT ga.goal_id, wa.account_id, fi.financial_institution_name AS financial_institution_name, wa.masked_account_number, wa.balance FROM goal g INNER JOIN goal_asset ga ON g.goal_id = ga.goal_id LEFT JOIN account da ON ga.asset_type = 'ACCOUNT' AND ga.asset_id = da.account_id LEFT JOIN money_box dm ON ga.asset_type = 'MONEY_BOX' AND ga.asset_id = dm.money_box_id INNER JOIN auto_transfer at ON (ga.asset_type = 'ACCOUNT' AND at.deposit_account_id = da.account_id) OR (ga.asset_type = 'MONEY_BOX' AND at.money_box_id = dm.money_box_id) INNER JOIN account wa ON at.withdrawal_account_id = wa.account_id LEFT JOIN financial_institution fi ON wa.financial_institution_id = fi.financial_institution_id WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} AND g.goal_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ga.asset_type IN ('ACCOUNT', 'MONEY_BOX') ORDER BY ga.goal_id, wa.account_id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM goal g JOIN goal_asset ga ON g.goal_id = ga.goal_id WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} AND ga.asset_type = #{assetType} AND ga.asset_id = #{assetId})
